name: my-game
description: A web game built with the Gamingalo SDK

scripts.publish:preview: npm run build && gamingalo game:publish --channel preview
scripts.publish:production: npm run build && gamingalo game:publish --channel production
scripts.ai:memory: uvx --prerelease=allow basic-memory project add my-game docs/memory
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run ai:check && npm run validate
